name: Uprigg

debut.episode: Let's Do the Time War Again

abilities: Disassembles and reassembles technology at manic speed (Juryrigg)
Modifies and improves technology (Upgrade) - built working Time Cycles from wreckage
weaknesses: No weaknesses documented on the wiki
Physically small and weak; a builder rather than a fighter
summary: Ben 10,000's Biomnitrix fusion of Juryrigg and Upgrade: a circuit-patterned gremlin who giggles his way through building time-travelling motorcycles out of scrap and a Chroniton particle.
traits: Biomnitrix symbol on his eye ring
notableFeats: Built two Time Cycles for Ben and Rook from a Chroniton Particle and the wreckage of the Proto-TRUK and Tenn-Speed (Let's Do the Time War Again)
Built a second pair of Time Cycles off-screen so Ben and Rook could return to their own time (Let's Do the Time War Again)

appearances.firstEpisode: Let's Do the Time War Again
notableEpisodes: Let's Do the Time War Again
appearances.designNotes: Juryrigg's body overlaid with Upgrade's green circuit pattern; slightly rounder arms, legs and stomach; a plug on the tail tip instead of a devil point; longer, pointier ears and nose; Biomnitrix symbol on the ring of his single eye (Upgrade's symbol spot).

scoring.rationale: A support specialist: Juryrigg's dismantling instinct plus Upgrade's tech-enhancement let him build functioning time machines from scrap, backed by stretchy reach. Almost no combat value shown, small and fragile, with a manic streak.

notes: One-time form used only by the Omniverse Ben 10,000 via the Biomnitrix (Let's Do the Time War Again, OV S8); second use was off-screen.
componentIds use 'jury-rigg' for the wiki page 'Juryrigg' per project id convention - verify against the base research file.

Biomnitrix context: the Omniverse Ben 10,000 (Original Future timeline, re-established as Ben Prime's true future) wears two linked Omnitrix gauntlets; slamming them together fuses two aliens on the fly (combinations are generated at transformation time, not stored). Each gauntlet alone gives normal aliens; it is voice-controlled and can be knocked out by a large EMP or Chronosapien time-freeze. All on-screen fusions were drawn by Thomas N. Perkins IV; the device name was coined by Derrick J. Wyatt (unnamed in scripts).
